name: Plane Parallel Radiance Transport for Vegetation
definition: A method to compute global illumination in dense vegetation by assuming radiance depends positionally only on height z (not x, y) and angularly on direction. This reduces partial differential equations (PDEs) for radiance transport to ordinary differential equations (ODEs) in z, allowing direct solution via Runge-Kutta instead of iterative methods.
summary: Plane Parallel Radiance Transport for Vegetation computes global illumination by reducing radiance transport to height-dependent ODEs solvable via Runge-Kutta, avoiding iterative methods.
